title: Thai-Style Fresh Herb and Noodle Rolls
summary: Light, fresh rice paper style rolls filled with rice noodles, crisp vegetables and fragrant Thai herbs, served with a tangy soy-lime dipping sauce. They make a refreshing vegan snack for warm days or a make-ahead platter.
steps: Cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender, usually 3–5 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water and shake off excess water well.
Toss the noodles with a pinch of salt and 1 tablespoon of the lime juice so they are lightly seasoned and do not clump.
Prepare the fillings: keep the lettuce, cucumber, carrot, bean sprouts, mint, coriander and spring onions in separate piles so the rolls are easy to assemble.
Make the dipping sauce by stirring together the soy sauce, remaining 1 tablespoon lime juice, sesame oil, sriracha and brown sugar until the sugar dissolves.

To assemble rice paper style rolls, lay a lettuce leaf or two flat as the wrapper substitute, then add a small bundle of noodles, carrot, cucumber, bean sprouts, herbs and spring onion across the centre.
Fold the sides of the lettuce over the filling, then roll up tightly from the bottom into a compact roll. Repeat with the remaining fillings.
Serve immediately with the dipping sauce, or cover the rolls with a damp clean cloth and chill for up to 2 hours before serving.
